title: Sheafification of the affine conormal wedge section equivalence
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], n a natural number, U an affine open of Y [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and V=i⁻¹U. Put A=Gamma(Y,U), I=(ker i).ideal(U) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], N=i*(ker i) [def-pc-module-pullback], E=exteriorSheaf N n [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], M=conormalExteriorModule A I n [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison], and T=tilde.functor A followed by restriction along the chart isoSpec, pushforward along U→Y, and tensor pullback along i [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. Every Gamma(Z,V)-linear equivalence e between the terminal section modules of E.over V and T(M).over V extends to an isomorphism s:E.over V ≅ T(M).over V whose terminal component equals e on every section. The equivalence e is an explicit parameter; no pure-wedge compatibility assumption is needed.

source.place: Lemmas 26.7.1, 26.7.2(2), 26.7.3(1), and 26.7.4; conormal identification from Tag 01R3(2) and canonical unit from Tag 0096.

proof.text: The inverse-image open V is affine by IsAffineOpen.preimage for the closed immersion. Prove quasi-coherence of the ideal module directly: it is the kernel of toPushforwardSubscheme, whose source is the structure module and whose target is the pushforward of the structure module of the closed subscheme. The source-library proved theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedImmersion supplies target quasi-coherence, and isQuasicoherent_kernel supplies ideal quasi-coherence. No affine ideal section identification is needed. Use leftAdjointUniq on exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction to compare tensorPullback with ordinary pullback; quasi-coherence of pullback gives conormal quasi-coherence.

Restrict the conormal module to the affine open scheme V. Apply isQuasicoherent_exteriorSheaf_of_isAffine to the restriction N|V, and transport quasi-coherence through the isomorphism exteriorSheaf_restrict_iso between (exterior power of N)|V and the exterior power of N|V, obtaining quasi-coherence of E.restrict V.ι.

Prove the affine model is quasi-coherent on V for every A-module M, not just the conormal exterior module. Write B for the chart restriction of tilde M and C=U.ι_* B; B is quasi-coherent. Set a=i.resLE U V le_rfl, so a followed by U.ι equals V.ι followed by i. Identify tensorPullback i with pullback i, restriction with pullback along V.ι, and compose pullbacks. Transport along resLE_comp_ι to pullback a of pullback U.ι of C. The open-immersion counit identifies restriction of C to U with B. The resulting isomorphism identifies (tensorPullback i C)|V with a*B, which is quasi-coherent. This never assumes that C is quasi-coherent on all of Y.

On an affine scheme, use the proved source-library AffineHom declarations exists_hom_app_top_eq_of_isAffine and hom_ext_of_isAffine (implementing the affine tilde-Gamma equivalence) to lift the given linear equivalence and its inverse. Compute the composites on top sections and use affine hom extensionality to prove they are identities, producing an actual isomorphism with the prescribed top component. To pass from the original terminal over-site sections to top sections on V, transport e along V.ι_image_top and the scalar isomorphism V.ι.appIso top. Conjugate the restricted isomorphism with the two overFunctorEquiv components and take overEquiv.functor.preimageIso. Evaluate map_preimage at top; the conjugating components reduce to identities and the result is the transported e. Transport back along V.ι_image_top to get the asserted terminal component equation. All helpers are proved; degree zero and empty charts are included.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_selfTor_conormal_wedge_chart_from_sections
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (n : ℕ) (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (e : let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules
      let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower N n
      let M := conormalExteriorModule (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
      let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
      ((E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).val.obj
            (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))))) ≃ₗ[Z.presheaf.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))]
          ((T.obj M).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).val.obj
            (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))))) :
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules
    let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower N n
    let M := conormalExteriorModule (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    ∃ s : E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ (T.obj M).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      ∀ x : (E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).val.obj
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))),
        s.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))) x =
          e x
